title: GoHighLevel Voice AI Pricing 2026: Cost Per Minute
description: GoHighLevel Voice AI pricing: $0.045/min engine plus voice fees pay-per-use, or unlimited on the $97 tier. Real call costs and limits. Verified July 2026.
html_content:
GoHighLevel Voice AI costs $0.045 per minute in engine fees plus a text-to-speech rate ($0.015–$0.170/min depending on the voice) plus model tokens when you pay per use — or it's included without limits on the $97/month AI Employee Unlimited plan, subject to fair use. Those are GoHighLevel's published rates as of July 2026. Phone-system charges apply on every call regardless of plan. Here's what a real call actually costs, in dollars.

Voice AI is the phone-answering piece of the AI Employee bundle — the full AI Employee review covers whether it's any good; this page is the meter.

How much does GoHighLevel Voice AI cost per minute?

When you're on Pay-Per-Use (or past the Growth plan's included minutes), a Voice AI call stacks three rates, per GoHighLevel's AI Product Pricing doc:

ComponentRateNotes
Voice Engine$0.045/minEffective May 20, 2026
Text-to-speech — OpenAI or Cartesia$0.015/minThe "standard voice" tier
Text-to-speech — ElevenLabs V2.5$0.035/minMid-tier premium voice
Text-to-speech — ElevenLabs V3$0.170/minTop-tier premium voice
LLM tokensvaries by modele.g. GPT-4o Mini $0.15/1M tokens; GPT-5 $1.25 in / $10.00 out per 1M
Phone systemseparate, alwaysCarrier/telephony charges on every call, every plan

What a call really costs: a typical 4-minute call runs about $0.25 with a standard voice ($0.18 engine + $0.06 speech + a cent or two of tokens) or about $0.86 with an ElevenLabs V3 voice — before phone charges. A 200-call month at 4 minutes a call lands roughly $50–$170 in AI usage.

Is Voice AI free on the $97 plan?

The AI usage is — AI Employee Unlimited at $97/month includes unlimited Voice AI minutes subject to fair use, which is why heavy users should skip the per-minute math entirely. The $50 Growth plan includes 100 Voice AI minutes a month (inbound, outbound, and widget combined) and bills overage at the pay-per-use rates above.

What is never free: telephony. GoHighLevel's pricing guide states that phone-system charges apply to all calls regardless of plan — budget roughly a cent or two per minute for carrier costs on top of whatever AI tier you pick. The tier-by-tier comparison lives in the AI Employee tier guide.

What languages and voices does Voice AI support?

More than most standalone receptionists: 340+ voices across 54+ languages, filterable by language, accent family (American, British, Australian and others), and gender — including ElevenLabs voices and custom ElevenLabs voice imports you can reuse across locations. Voice choice is also a pricing decision: a standard OpenAI or Cartesia voice bills at $0.015/min while an ElevenLabs V3 voice bills at $0.170/min, more than 11× the speech cost. Pick premium voices for the lines where sound quality sells; leave internal or after-hours lines on standard voices.

One honest caveat from GoHighLevel's own ideas board: users still reported non-English spelling struggles (names, emails) as recently as February 2026. If most of your callers aren't English speakers, test your language before rolling it out.

Can Voice AI transfer a call to a real person?

Yes — and this is the feature that makes an AI receptionist safe to put on a real phone line, so budget setup time for it. GoHighLevel's during-call actions include a Call Transfer action that hands the live call to a human phone number when conditions you define are met — caller asks for a person, mentions an emergency, or hits a question the agent can't answer. Two details worth knowing before you configure it:

  • Transfers are condition-based, not magic. You write the conditions in the agent setup; an agent with no transfer conditions will keep talking no matter how frustrated the caller gets. Test the escalation path with real calls before going live.
  • Agents can also transfer to other AI agents — Voice AI agent transfer routes a call from a generalist reception agent to a specialist one (booking, support) before a human ever needs to pick up. The transferred leg is still Voice AI time, so it bills at the same per-minute rates on pay-per-use.

Are there usage limits on Voice AI calls?

Yes, and they're generous but real, per GoHighLevel's outbound calling doc and inbound rate-limit doc:

  • Outbound: up to 1,000 Voice AI calls per location per day, paced at 10 calls per minute; each contact number can be called once per day (max 14 times in 14 days), between 8am and 8pm in the contact's timezone, same-country only.
  • Inbound: a Voice AI number receiving more than 200 calls per minute triggers a violation and blocks that call; more than 5 violations in an hour blocks all inbound calls account-wide until support restores them.

A normal local business won't touch these. Aggressive outbound campaigns should respect the violations guardrail.

Frequently asked questions

How much does GoHighLevel Voice AI cost per minute?

At pay-per-use rates: $0.045/min engine fee, plus $0.015–$0.170/min text-to-speech depending on the voice, plus model tokens — roughly $0.06–$0.22 per minute all-in for the AI, before phone charges. On the $97/month Unlimited plan the AI usage is included.

How much does a 5-minute AI phone call cost on GoHighLevel?

About $0.30–$0.35 with a standard voice at pay-per-use rates, or about $1.08 with a premium ElevenLabs V3 voice — plus a few cents of telephony. On the Unlimited plan: just the telephony.

Does GoHighLevel Voice AI speak Spanish?

Yes — the voice catalog spans 54+ languages including Spanish, with 340+ voices. Users have reported the AI can struggle spelling names and emails in non-English calls, so test your specific use case during a trial.

Can Voice AI make outbound calls?

Yes, up to 1,000 per location per day with compliance checks and pacing limits. Outbound AI calling has consent rules under the TCPA — the full review covers the legal basics, and none of this is legal advice.

How does GoHighLevel Voice AI pricing compare to hiring an answering service?

Live answering services bill by the human minute, at rates several times what the AI meter charges. Voice AI at pay-per-use runs under a quarter per minute with a standard voice, and flat $97/month at volume — the trade-off is a machine, not a person, on your front line. The full GoHighLevel pricing guide covers the platform cost underneath.
